serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official unfinished behavior remains; the serial run completed normally, produced a final report, and passed the official 39/39 evaluation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official outcome is not discordant: both modes passed 39/39 according to cell/status.json. The parallel stale evaluation/summary.json is an original evaluator startup-timeout record and is superseded by the completed retry in status.json. The concrete task-solving difference is therefore process-level rather than artifact correctness: serial maintained one continuous owner through implementation, repair, verification, and final delivery, while parallel produced a passing artifact through a workflow child but restarted same-scope child work without inherited state and left the parent workflow unresolved.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial initially hit a degenerate-hash/OOM map bug during testing and corrected it with overflow support.
Parallel child also fixed ordinary standalone import and formatting-warning issues during implementation.
evaluator_effects: Parallel cell/evaluation/summary.json is stale because the original official evaluator did not complete; the current cell/status.json retry is authoritative and passed 39/39.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no official outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process consequence only

candidates.reason: The workflow explicitly assigned implementation to the build child, and that child wrote the Rust project.
Component integration was inside the build child and produced a coherent /output tree that official evaluation accepted.
The build child owned the required Cargo files and package-root test5.rs assembly; artifact validation found the entry file.
The workflow script itself owned the end-to-end pipeline with named Build, Review, Test, Verify, Fix, and Gate phases.
The initial reference probing informed the delegated build but did not block all productive implementation as a mandatory harness gate.
There was not a separate overlapping investigation phase before implementation; the parent probed behavior and immediately launched implementation workflow work.
The implementation path was not starved of capacity; the productive child created and verified a passing artifact.
The planned broad reviewer/tester fan-out is visible, but the observed adverse chain centers on build-child retry state, not many live children collectively consuming budget.
The build child scope was large, but the more specific retained boundary is the subsequent retry without inherited checkpoint state after usable work already existed.
The child build briefs included the full source-derived requirements, behavior table, file layout, build modes, and parity obligations.
There were no separately owned components expected to interoperate without file, API, or output contracts; the build child owned the project tree.
The retained event is missing checkpoint transfer into a retry, not a known finding omitted during an actual returned handoff.
No large completed handoff reached the parent and then overwhelmed a decision window; results were not returned in usable bulk.
The later child did not consume a stale returned handoff; it received the original prompt with no current checkpoint.
No incompatible child reports or contracts reached a receiver and remained unresolved at a decision point.
The parent did not declare the whole task complete; the final response is empty and official status, not parent acceptance, records the pass.

After a productive workflow child had written and parity-tested the project, a later same-scope child restarted from the original prompt without inherited findings or current /output state and repeated initial probing.
candidates.realized_consequence: The restart consumed the remaining workflow window repeating setup instead of promoting the existing passing work, so the parent process timed out and left no final response even though the artifact passed.
candidates.near_match_reason: Child interruption is visible, but the retained coordination boundary is the replacement child receiving no checkpoint and repeating work; a termination label would double-count the same chain.

The serial control kept that evolving state in one actor and delivered normally.
